newsitem.title: JAPAN: Korea Container Terminal mulling samurais--sources.
newsitem.headline: Korea Container Terminal mulling samurais--sources.

text.p: South Korea's state-owned Korea Container Terminal Authority is considering launching about 4.3 billion yen worth of samurai bonds with a maturity of 10 years as early as mid-July, underwriting sources said on Thursday.
They said the lead-manager has yet to be decided.
They added that the payment day is likely to be around late July or early August.
In October, Korea Container Terminal Authority issued five billion yen worth of 2.2 percent samurai bonds due October 18, 2001. They were lead-managed by Kokusai Securities.
